summary.headline: Dodecatemoria and Zodiacal Disposition
summary.text: Definitions of astrological enclosure by malefic and benefic stars, followed by the dodecatemoria of zodiacal signs, including a Moon-in-Cancer example yielding Aquarius. A proem from Hephaestio outlines the zodiacal circle, its twelve places, planetary configurations, and elemental, gendered, equinoctial, and tropical classifications.
